name: Kingsley Pines Camp
description_short: Family-owned coed overnight camp on Panther Lake in Raymond, Maine, for ages 8 to 16. Two-, three- and five-week sessions plus a one-week Explorer program for rising 3rd to 5th graders, with campers choosing their own activities: waterfront, arts, ropes and zip-lines, rafting and sports.
refund_policy_summary: If you cancel before April 1, 2027, you get a full refund minus a $500 cancellation fee per child. No refunds after April 1, 2027. A $1,000 deposit is required to enroll. Installment plans are available. Siblings get 5% off for each additional child.
swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront on Panther Lake: sailing, canoeing, swimming, wakeboarding, a water trampoline and a 14-foot floating climbing tower.

sessions.name: 1 Week Explorer Program – Week 1 (rising 3rd to 5th graders only)
Teen Leadership Program (3 weeks, returning campers only, 18 spaces)
